seasons.description: Season 3 brings the massive new Railway to Golmud map — the biggest in Battlefield 6 — alongside three BF3/BF4-era weapons (M16A4, RPK-74M, L115) and Ranked Play for REDSEC Battle Royale Quads with a full competitive ladder from Rookie to Elite.

The current Battlefield 6 season adds Nightfall content across Battlefield 6 and REDSEC, introducing new map content, modes, weapons, vehicles, and seasonal progression themed around fighting through darkness.

The first live season launched shortly after release and introduced Rogue Ops, followed by additional themed updates such as California Resistance and Winter Offensive as part of Battlefield 6's first seasonal content cycle.
